thread:
maria: Quick idea — prototyping a small 'release-assist' CLI extension for the deploy bot. Goal: auto-generate preflight checks, attach a compact release-note stub, and create a one-line rollback alias.
ben: Nice. Is this mostly templating + synthetic checks?
carla: Would love if it could stitch metrics checks from the dash as a single check block (p50, error-rate, db QPS).
deploy-bot: @maria I can accept a `--preflight` arg with comma list (smoke,synthetic,db). Example: `/deploy assist --service=api --tag=2026.03.18 --preflight=smoke,synthetic --notes-from=git:CHANGELOG.md`
alice: Suggest we include a `--change-window` flag so ops knows when to expect traffic vs pin windows: `--change-window=2026-03-19T22:00Z/60m`
maria: Exactly. Drafted quick UX: 
```
/deploy assist --service=payments --tag=canary-20260318 --preflight=synthetic,smoke --change-window=2026-03-19T22:00Z/60m --notes-template=release/short
```
carla: What does the bot produce? Example output pls.
deploy-bot: Sample response below when launched: 
```
Deploy Assist started for payments @ canary-20260318
Preflight jobs queued: synthetic-check, smoke-test
Synthetic checks: p50_latency < 120ms, error_rate < 0.5% (monitored 2m)
Smoke: service startup + simple end-to-end flow
Release notes stub: (editable)
- canary-20260318: small pricing fix
Escapes: `rb last` -> roll back to previous tag, `rb 1h` -> rollback to state 1 hour prior
Change window: 2026-03-19 22:00Z (60m)
```
sre-oncall: We should make the synthetic-check configurable to pull thresholds from `deploy.quality.*` entries. Don't hardcode numbers in the bot.
dave: Also want an optional `--dryverify` that runs all checks but doesn't create release notes or touch pins. Handy for rehearsals.
maria: Good call. UX idea for rollback shorthand: `rb <delta>` resolves to a pinned tag or timestamp; bot posts the exact `kubectl`/manifest step as a single-line escape hatch. Example: `rb 15m` -> `kubectl set image svc/payments payments=img@sha256:<resolved>`
ben: Can the notes-template accept references to PRs/commits auto-scraped? Like `--notes-from=git:HEAD..origin/main` or `--commits=5`
carla: +1. Also flag for `--slo-check` that enforces post-deploy traffic slice checks. If failed, bot auto-annotates release and triggers rollback if `--auto-rollback` is set.
maria: Proposed default check set: [smoke, synthetic-p50, error-rate, db-connections]. Optional extras: slo-check, canary-traffic-verify.
deploy-bot: Implementation notes: supports `--dryrun`, `--auto-rollback`, `--notify=#channel` and outputs a markdown-ish release stub you can edit in the release thread. Example stub: 
```
Release draft for payments/canary-20260318
- PRs: #4321, #4319
- Notes: Fix rounding bug in billing
- Preflight: synthetic OK, smoke OK
- Post-deploy checks (T+5m): p50=95ms, errors=0.2%
Approve to promote -> `/deploy promote <tag>`
```
alice: For security we need an allowed-flag list per team. Only certain services can use `--auto-rollback` and pinned promote flows. Add RBAC check.
maria: Yep — control plane will gate flag usage. Also adding a `--template=brief|full|none` so smaller teams get one-liners.
sre-oncall: Ops considerations: ensure these checks are idempotent and don't create noisy alerts. Also add a `--quiet` mode that suppresses channel pings until human ack.
dave: Next steps: I'll spin a tiny PoC that uses our synthetic runner + the deploy-bot adapter. Plan to wire notes-from via `git rev-list` and extract PR numbers. Will open a draft RFC doc with examples.
maria: Thanks. If people want to help prototyping, ping me. Thinking to land this as an opt-in feature behind a feature flag for Q2 experiments. :eyes: :rocket:
